# Myoseon
> Korean emotional creative hub with essays, stories, photography, and art galleries.

## About
Myoseon is a personal creative site centered on warm writing, emotional essays, photo essays, and visual galleries. It connects the Myoseon story archive, art gallery, and photo exhibition.

## Sections
- Stories and essays: https://book.myoseon.kr/
- Art gallery: https://art.myoseon.kr/
- Photo exhibition: https://photo.myoseon.kr/

## Features
- Emotional essays and short writing
- Korean creative writing archive
- Art and photo gallery links
- Calm, minimal browsing experience
- Personal creative brand by Myoseon
